item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is making a chart of the Solar System for her school science exhibition in Jaipur. She lists the planets in increasing distance from the Sun and groups them as inner and outer planets.

Which list shows the correct order of the eight planets from the Sun?

options.A: Mercury, Mars, Venus, Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune, Uranus
options.B: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
options.C: Venus, Mercury, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Saturn, Neptune
options.D: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Earth, Saturn, Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune
